subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: Twitter: The Global Town Square
description: One-minute skill: Twitter: The Global Town Square.

hook.text: Jack Dorsey sent the first tweet on March 21, 2006: 'just setting up my twttr.'

buildup.text: The 140-character limit forced brevity. Ideas had to be sharp to fit.

discovery.text: Twitter became the place where news broke first — often before television or newspapers.

twist.text: The same openness that powered revolutions also enabled misinformation at massive scale.

climax.text: Twitter proved that real-time public conversation could reshape politics and culture.

punchline.text: A character limit shaped global conversation.

quiz.question: What was Twitter's original character limit?
